# Resume Music

{% hint style="warning" %}
This action requires a [Premium Subscription](/premium/premium-and-priority-hosting-plans.md#premium-plans) to function.
{% endhint %}

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FK55JaRaBkJlc3NuvulzM%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=31ff79ef-ec9f-4ced-866e-7ba92d4349cf" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Resume Music action lets you resume the music track after it has been paused.

## Server

This setting allows you to target a server. You have two options to select from:

{% tabs %}
{% tab title="Current Server" %}

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FdZi7kCHWcPIzH3Vy7YTs%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=df700045-b8a4-47b7-8d57-9325b8adb8dd" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

When you select the 'Current Server' option, the music track of the current server will be resumed.
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="Server ID" %}

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2Fnq7vvs73QqY5L1VKI6nd%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=7cafbf44-babc-4557-9d10-6d88823213f2" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

When you select the 'Server ID' option, the music track of the provided server ID will be resumed.

### Server ID

In this field you can enter the ID of the server where you want to resume the music track. Variables can be used in this field.
{% endtab %}
{% endtabs %}
